title: Small steps: Two choices that are both real
categoryContext: Early years and first school transitions
stageSummary: Offer real choices, preparation and participation without handing over the adult responsibility.
pressureLine: Do you want to do it or not?
possibleWeather: Young children may hear a pressured sentence as a message about who they are. Keep the language short, concrete and close to the next action.
practice: choose between two workable ways to begin
principle: Use bounded choices that offer agency without false options.
nextSentence: The required task remains. First, choose between two workable ways to begin.
keyLearning: Use bounded choices that offer agency without false options.
